name: Can I remove a load-bearing wall myself to save money?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove a load-bearing wall myself to save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting to remove a load-bearing wall without professional expertise is highly discouraged due to significant safety risks and potential structural damage to your home. Improper removal can lead to ceiling sagging, cracks, or even collapse. It also requires structural engineering plans and permits, which are not typically accessible to homeowners for DIY projects. Hometelligent Inc. emphasizes that this type of project should always be handled by licensed and experienced contractors to ensure safety and compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, removing a load-bearing wall without professional expertise is unsafe and can lead to severe structural damage or collapse.
